reviews.title: Disappointing Results and Paywall After One Try
reviews.text:
I was really excited to try Toon app because the idea of creating AI photos and videos sounded awesome. Unfortunately, the experience was pretty frustrating. The biggest issue is that the AI doesn’t make faces look recognizable at all. The photos it generated barely looked like the original person — facial features were distorted, proportions were off, and sometimes it looked like a completely different person. For an app that’s supposed to specialize in AI visuals, I expected much better accuracy and realism.

On top of that, you only get to try one video before the app pushes you to pay. One video is nowhere near enough to properly test whether the app is worth subscribing to. It feels like you don’t really get a fair trial before being hit with a paywall. There aren’t enough free features to actually explore what the app can do.

Overall, Tune feels more like a demo than a usable app unless you’re ready to spend money immediately. Between the unrecognizable faces and the extremely limited free access, I wouldn’t recommend it unless major improvements are made.
